description: A realistic static `<md>` body renders as exactly the §67.6 closed element tree inside one host `div` (author `class` on the host): headings with slug ids, paragraphs, strong/em/del/code, links with title, an ordered list starting at 3, a quote, a rule, an aligned table, a hard break and an image.

rationale: §67.6 (MD-SAFE): an `<md>` produces only the elements of the §67.6 table, each with only its listed attributes; content reaches the DOM only as text or a listed attribute; a static heading gets a slug id; `ol` writes `start` only when it is not 1; `th`/`td` alignment is one of three `text-align` constants.
